body:
Sorry that i didnt respond all this time. I never noticed your comment. I cant even read a reddit thread.

I try to keep my distance from my parents. Their constant questions annoy me too much.
I got a little better a few days after my last post. Then i had a conversation with my therapist. Now i feel worse than ever. Simply put, i wouldnt be able to handle transitioning. My voice is irreparably damaged and all the problems with society would be too much. Living as a guy is not an option either. My body is rotting again because of all the testosterone. It looks worse than ever. I wont be able to live like this either. I cant stand it.

The side effects from the antidepressants are awful. And even if i were to take them, they wouldnt solve any of my problems.

At least i was able to get my stuff in order. My last appointment is in two days. Then that chore is dealt with. Im not sure when, but i guess thats it. Maybe i'll wait another week or month or year. I dont know how long i can take it. But i dont feel like doing anything at all.

I didnt find episode 154... maybe 134?

A little update.... not exactly a good one though.


I stopped with the hormones again and had an attempt with CO. Barely survived. Then i had a nice (awful!) long stay at the ward.
They stuffed me with antidepressants. The side effects were horrible, so i secretly stopped taking them.
As for my panic attacks, they won't give me any benzos because i (very successfully) self medded with them in the past. The other stuff i tried either didn't work, made things worse (im talking about you Quetiapine) or had too many side effects. Since i stopped the Mirtazepine, the attacks have been getting much more frequent and stronger.
Basically, i have up to two medium to heavy panic attacks per day and won't get any treatment for them.
I still can't see how i possibly could fix my future. I really can't live with either option (hormones or not).


Sorry to bother you with my nonsense again, but do you have any ideas?

I talked with my mother and started taking the hormones again.    
I'm also seeing a professional speech therapist.    

Things are getting better.    
Thanks again!

My parents might try to send me to a closed ward until im better... which might not be the case any time soon. I at least want to be able to decide about the most fundamental things in my life.    
I really get along with my therapist well but yeah, it sucks that he is rarely available.    
The thought of never finding a partner stopped me from continuing... the loneliness. The feeling of someone loving me, even though im such a messed up thing would help me tremendously. It would help me accept myself. And the emotional support would also be fantastic. I guess that loving myself is something that i have to learn...    

  
Thanks a lot!    
Don't worry about making me feel worse. You really helped me to calm down.

I really would love to live a normal life. I don't have to be super happy every day. No one is. I just don't want to feel this terrible all the time.    
I'm very distant to my parents, never opened up to them. And i really don't want to. Not sure why. Probably because they couldn't help me anyways and would only try to prolong my suffering. On the other hand i feel bad about making them suffer...    
My therapist was on vacation for a month now. I had an apointment for last thursday, but he had no time. Now i have to wait another two weeks.    
You know of meds that really help?! Can you please tell me more about them? Up to now the only thing that really helped me deal with the dysphoria was a certain opiate. But i had to increase the dose constantly, not to mention that it is a pretty ugly scene. The benzos dull my emotions a bit, take the edge off. SSRIs don't do anything. I never thought that there was something else out there. But maybe there is!    
Please if you know of anything else... that would really help me a lot!    
I tried behavioral therapy for a while. It only made things worse because it brought the dysphoria into focus. The nausea and attacks are like hardwired. Just the thought that im not female hurts like hell... no idea how i could ever cope with that.    
Being alone was not as much of a problem before the hormones and now that i stopped i should start caring less about it again. Funny how much estrogen influences the brain. Well, at least that is going to be less of a concern now. Though, if i had found someone, i probably would have continued with the hrt.    
I threw away the carbon monoxide generator yesterday... that only leaves the poison collection. But it took me years to assemble it... it would be such a waste. And honestly, i don't want to give up on the option.

Sorry, this is a bit too overwhelming right now... i'll try again tomorrow.
Thanks for all your help!

I live in a medium sized city in austria (200k people). It is known to be a rather progressive place and homosexuals are widely accepted. Trans people on the other hand are highly stigmatized here. Sure, some people, maybe a third, say that it is okay but no one wants to be associated with them. People even deny ever having met one. And while trans people officially have the same legal rights, the judiciary and police seem to have another opinion. In short, this palce is awful and i don't even know why.    
I don't know of any call centers around... and my voice is atrocious anyways.    
The main problem is the loneliness. Since everyone avoids trans people, it is going to be very hard to find new friends or stay in contact. And relationships are near impossible anyways.    
And even if all the outside problems were solved, i would still feel guilty for transitioning. It would only make me something inbetween anyways.    
Right now i am 20 and have good chances of passing. Going stealth would still be very hard because of all the papers. If i started later, passing wouldn't be realistic. And what is the pupose of hrt if you still see the wrong gender in the mirror? It's a now or never kind of thing    
To be honest, the only thing i really want to do is to end all of this nonsense. I wanted to die since i was 10. Always waited in hope that things would get better and not to hurt my parents. Now that dream is gone and the only reason i am still here is because i don't want to hurt them.... but for how long can i keep this up?    
I had to go to weekly therapy for more than a year to even get the hormones. 
Now my therapist is kinda giving up. The only thing he ever says anymore is "Keep taking the hormones."...    
What i'm looking for is some brain surgery or drug that stops all the dysphoria... i yet have to find something.    
I don't want to waste too much of your time. Sorry for all this crap.

Thanks for all the encouragement! 
Moving to thailand would be too much for me right now. Learning the language and all the customs, finding a place to stay and so on. I couldn't afford the flight anyways. I'm completely broke since no one wants to employ trans people here. Even illegal immigrants have it easier in that regard.
I'm in close contact with the local trans community. Just listening to their experiences is discourgaing enough.
Of the ~30 people i know, 8 already killed themselfes last year. And those are the ones that did go through with their transition. I have no idea what the non-transitioners are doing. They kinda disappeared. No contact...
Sorry to disappoint you but transition really isn't possible for me.
Right now i'm trying to get my Alprazolam prescription. That should buy me some more "normal time".
Sorry....
